summary: Address code smell: Shotgun Surgery: errors locals in koru bootstrap validation

delivery.outcome: Rename the generic error-list local 'errors' to stage-accurate names in each of the seven functions of src/koru/bootstrap.py that mutate it: id_errors (_validate_id, missing/duplicate id findings), executor_errors (_validate_executor, executor.kind/executor.mode findings), blocked_by_errors (_validate_blocked_by, non-string blocked_by entry findings), task_violations (_validate_task, the per-task accumulator across all field validators), dependency_errors (_validate_cross_task_dependencies, unknown blocked_by references and the dependency cycle), pipeline_errors (validate_flat_pipeline, the whole-pipeline aggregation) and validation_errors (import_flat_pipeline, the validation gate before materialisation). The code2llm shotgun-surgery detector groups mutations by (file, variable) and fires at >= 5 scopes; the 'errors' group drops from 7 scopes to 0. Each new name lands at 1 scope, so no (file, variable) group grows toward the threshold. Pure rename of function-internal locals; no signature, return shape or behavior change; no other file touched.
nonGoals: No behavior, validation semantics or interface change
No restructuring into a returned-findings (pure) validator chain; each helper already owns one validation stage, the shared generic name was the defect, not a missing abstraction
No rename of locals in other files that happen to use 'errors' (each is an independent local in its own file scope)

architecture.decision: Stage-accurate local renames only, inside one module. Every function that appends validation findings names its error channel after the validation stage it serves (id, executor, blocked_by entries, per-task aggregation, cross-task dependencies, whole-pipeline aggregation, import-time validation gate); the generic name 'errors' disappears from the file's mutation set entirely. Verified with the installed code2llm DFGExtractor mutation grouping on the file's AST (standalone extract, since ProjectAnalyzer.analyze on copies/worktrees silently yields empty scopes): baseline reports an 'errors' mutation group of exactly 7 scopes - _validate_id, _validate_executor, _validate_blocked_by, _validate_task, _validate_cross_task_dependencies, validate_flat_pipeline, import_flat_pipeline - matching the ticket's 'spans 7 functions'; after the rename the 'errors' group is empty and no new (file, variable) group reaches the >= 5 threshold.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; the locals are named errors again and the smell report returns.

commands: python3 -c "<standalone code2llm DFGExtractor mutation grouping on the file AST, original vs renamed content of src/koru/bootstrap.py>"
validation.evidence: Deterministic ground truth with the installed code2llm extractor on the file AST. Baseline content reports an 'errors' mutation group of 7 scopes (_validate_id, _validate_executor, _validate_blocked_by, _validate_task, _validate_cross_task_dependencies, validate_flat_pipeline, import_flat_pipeline; 17 records) - exactly matching the ticket's reported 'spans 7 functions'. Renamed content reports an 'errors' group of 0 scopes; file mutation record count unchanged at 115 (pure rename); every renamed local lands at 1 scope, far below the >= 5 threshold.
The suite that exercises the renamed validation paths passes unchanged - pure rename of function-internal locals - and ruff reports zero errors on the touched file.
GOV-PASS 0 errors 0 warnings from the ticket worktree with the changed files declared.
